status: reconciled curriculum design proposal; canonical contract remains coordinator-owned
title: Connected exposition, praise, and figurative language
productive_outcomes: Produce every assigned productive cell of the selected complete nominal, adjectival and verbal systems, applying the evidenced stem changes, endings, exceptions and bounded senses together.
Keep each complete clause's subject, object, recipient and internal relative role distinct across comparison, report, condition, coordination and participial expansion.
Distinguish second-person commands, third-person wishes and statements in praise, blessing and petition; retain each original Cook omission, lexical and word-order control.

Use the specifically assigned nominalized adjective and participial frames with their own case roles and governed dependents; do not derive unrestricted substantival syntax merely from prior adjectival morphology.
Interpret equality, greater degree, comparison of actions, metaphor and simile without replacing the literal structure by an unsupported paraphrase.

Use each explicitly taught new lexical sense and government, including familiar-headword meanings that the actual prior register does not establish; use printed local help for deliberately supplied expressions.

Translate all 82 unchanged Cook joint XII, XIII.37–43 prompts, retaining every clause, enumerated member, participant and stated control; distinguish valid Old English from compliance with a narrower exercise target.
recognition_outcomes: Translate the complete252word music-performance episode with its local help, from the daughter's performance through the criticism, demonstration and audience response.
Trace the speaker, addressee, antecedents and grammatical roles through the nested reports and compare a reported belief with a narrator's assertion.
Explain the source's bounded figurative and performance meanings from the actual Old English and supplied notes; preserve its printed variants and number choices.
Distinguish a source quotation, an exact English prompt, a documented normalization, supplied reading help and new teaching material.
Recognize that an exact dictionary hint or displayed frame is an input/reference position; using it correctly does not certify its independent recall.
bounded_scope: Only the actual sixteen active coverage contracts and actual registers at the coordinator's defa800 baseline establish prior teaching. No archived-course milestone is imported.

The baseline has 1,067 lemmas, 11,188 forms, 1,376 senses, and 1,080 features. Form, sense and construction knowledge are independent records; a matching string or familiar lemma does not close all three dependencies.

All 82 numbered prompts remain under the joint XII, XIII heading, with original IDs and English prompts unchanged except the source audit's declared typography normalization. No item-level redistribution is currently proposed.

Exercise 37's global omission of the article and second-person pronoun applies to its complete set; it does not prohibit third-person subjects in wishes or create a universal Old English article rule.

Complete tables display all literal assigned cells with productive/reference/supplied status. Complete noun classes include both singular and plural; a proper name, plural ethnonym or genuinely bounded system has its evidence-supported shape, without fabricated cells.
An abstract/mass sense's reference plural does not grant a new count meaning. A full verbal system grants only the expressly stated moods, tense series, nonfinite forms and lexical frames.

The high quantities in 39.2 and 42.2 require complete visible phrase help unless the reconciled contract deliberately teaches a full bounded numeral system. They cannot become independent recall tests from bare English prompts.

Negative knowing in 43.8 can use verified ne plus positive witan; no nytan paradigm is introduced merely because the English proposition is negative. The source's exact nāst in 174.18 remains separately classified.
Literal wǣre in 38.9 is a visible original hint. Its contextual comparative use needs explanation but does not by itself establish a universal comparative-subjunctive rule.

The checked reading is 174.7–175.17, a coherent episode within A Lesson in Music. Individual lines are editorial counts anchored by printed marginal numbers. The intervening earlier feast and later love/gifts paragraph are not newly assigned.

All 19 original notes and 20 anchors remain separate from modern help. A note's Latin corroboration supports interpretation but does not replace the actual Old English text or create an extra Latin translation task.

Source-specific expressions, proper-name spellings and deliberately supplied Cook frames remain visible during assessment. Supply their actual forms, local sense and argument structure together; never test unsupported independent recollection.

Four short new translated examples have exact prior form/sense/feature bindings. No additional connected invented narrative is proposed. Five original morphology groups contain 21 explicit outputs with exact system and dependency bindings.
Current proposals and all author-only models are excluded from the fresh blind learner solver until every actual requested output is attempted and frozen.
teaching_order_rule: Teach the selected sense and whole lexical frame, then the complete bounded paradigm with literal cells and rules, before independent practice; put complete local support before any scaffolded task. A form table alone never closes a sense or construction gap.

study_sequence.title: Complete new systems and ordinary lexical frames

study_sequence.additional_form_tasks: Five task seeds contain 21 explicit outputs: cniht possession/recipients, cwēn case contrast, fox/hol/nest number and location, hęrian mood/person syncretism, and nominalized participle outer versus inner case. Exact new inventory/evidence binding is required before contract.

study_sequence.content: Commands versus wishes, coordinated catalogues, nominalized adjectives/participles, dependent genitives, local figurative sense.
study_sequence.preservation: Keep all 14 items and its global instruction together.
